scriptName: Install Nginx & Virtual Host Domain Manager
description: Installs and configures Nginx web server with SQLite database persistence and declarative INI synchronization on Windows.

messages.notAdmin: This script must be run as Administrator.
messages.scriptDisabled: Nginx installation is disabled in config.
messages.configTuning: Configuring Nginx with FastCGI support on port {port}...

commands.rm: Remove virtual host domain, unlink config, and update SQLite/INI (--purge)
commands.list: List all registered domains in tabular format or JSON (--json)
commands.ini: Display domains.ini configuration ledger or synchronize with SQLite (--sync)
commands.showcase: Run interactive before/after showcase of SQLite DB and INI file mutations
commands.status: Show current Nginx running status and registered domains
